comments.author: DBravo
comments.body:
Discovery obtained from Archeology map Map of Large Stone in Woods. The map is a random reward from any city Scholar after recharting the Karnak land area.

Note; this was very difficult map to acquire. I reinvestigated Karnak 12 times repeatedly and was still not granted the map. Over time, I probably recharted Karnak 20-25 times before I was given the map. But the drop rate is likely random and you might get luckier with an earlier reward.
